senses.gloss: f. (Pol. of גּוּס = גּוּז, Syr. גוס P. Sm. 686) rapidly passing away, sinking, dying. Ohol. I, 6; a. fr.—
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 71b:12">Kidd. 71ᵇ</cite> <he>עילם ג׳</he> Elam is to be despaired of (with reference to purity of descent, v. <cite ref="B01239"><he>בָּרִי</he></cite>).—Pl. <he>גּוֹסְסִים</he>, <he>גּוֹסְסִין</he>; f. <he>גּוֹסְסוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Gittin 28a:7">Gitt. 28ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>רוב ג׳ למיתה</he> the majority of those believed to be in a dying condition, really die.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 1:6:7">Y. Yeb. I, 3ᵇ</cite> top (of genealogical descent, v. supra). V. <cite ref="C00778"><he>גִּיסָה</he></cite>, <cite ref="C00680"><he>גִּיזָה</he></cite>.
